summary: This tutorial explains how to conduct peer review using LibreOffice Writer's document peer review feature. It starts by opening an existing document and enabling "Record Changes" to track edits. Users can add comments, delete text, or make changes that are clearly visible in the document. The author can accept or reject these changes and then incorporate them back into the document. The tutorial demonstrates this process using Linux and LibreOffice Suite version 3.34. Key steps include setting up "Record Changes," inserting new text, deleting text, and adding comments. The document shows multiple edits and deletions made by different reviewers, with each change highlighted in a different color for easy identification. The tutorial also highlights how multiple people can edit the same document simultaneously, with each edit shown separately to help the reader understand the changes.
